request.description:
Manual pump control. Automatically disables AI automation (pump_auto_mode=false).
value: 0=off, 1=on
duration_seconds (optional): auto-off timer in seconds (only when value=1)

Toggle AI automation for this pump node.
auto_mode: true  → AI engine controls pump (default)
auto_mode: false → Manual override; AI automation suspended

Re-enable AI after manual control by calling with auto_mode=true.
Turn pump ON for exactly duration_seconds, then auto-off. Also suspends AI automation.
Turn pump OFF manually. Also suspends AI automation.
Comprehensive AI analysis using the node's latest sensor readings from DB. No body needed.
AI pump recommendation using latest sensor readings + current pump state from DB. No body needed.
Harvest grade prediction using 7-day sensor averages from DB.
Runs anomaly detection for all sensors of this node using latest DB readings. No body needed.
